reapack.name: jf_tracker.lua
reapack.desc: jf_tracker - tracker view of REAPER with Vim keys

version.author: jeeruff
version.changelog: - fix: 0.9.1 crashed on start (jf_tracker.lua:618) - thanks for the report - pan view (zvp, zvP - every track): the track as a stereo field of 5..65 positions, notes at their pan, audio as a narrow spectral wave; h l, 20h = L20, H L move the note, w b dw x; typing goes beside (on a note - replaces it) - freesound.org pane (Ctrl+W c f, :freesound): search, listen with a wave, authors as folders, marks, sort, pages; files and CREDITS.txt per author - custom modules: your own panes from Data/jf_tracker_modules (API.md, section 4) - browser: a small wave at every row, the view menu (peaks / rectified / spectral, normalize), the path line clickable with f labels, the wheel only scrolls - tour: starts in a new empty tab with an 8-bit amen in the lib, panes and tracks step, hints where the keys go - f labels: bars only, the focused module first, then the previous one; :screensets; Cmd+V into the command line and searches - fonts without the Nerd icons: the download is 3.5 MB instead of 14

version.author: jeeruff
version.changelog: - mixer router (router button): the mixer split in half - every channel with its devices next to the fader and cables in the colour of the track: sends, folders, hardware outs; drag the line to share the height - mixer: armed tracks show a split meter - the input (red) and what goes out, every channel of the track; declip resets peaks and clips by itself; sends / router / declip buttons; one pan / width knob (disc - pan, ring - width) - narrow mixer strips: the track name and its effects on top, knobs and faders in one line - matrix: repeats are pooled now (P, U unpool - REAPER pooling); a - new slot with its name, c - change the pattern of the slot, A - the region playlist pane (seq, song playlist, arrangements) - patterns: a patternize button (regions as patterns, or as sections with patterns every N bars); pattern codes - renumber in order (A1 B1 C1 ...) - tracker: a view button top left (rulers, the tracker, the screen); zT zooms the track, zt is the Vim row-to-top; th tH tU hide / show hidden / unhide a track; note columns left, command columns right - browser: tabs in one order everywhere (db fav files fx libs pm proj recent), Tab in the fx list goes to the next tab; CONTROL is one mode (Ctrl+Opt, Shift - fine) and takes only what is on screen - tracks: narrowing all tracks goes step by step (the widest first, folded ones stay); a wide track shows cut at the edge, the track scrollbar is also under the mixer and scrolls past it - fixes: plugin windows over DSP stay put and leave with it, the master clip resets, small labels with TTF fonts, the matrix crash on start

version.author: jeeruff
version.changelog: - fix: Windows crashed on start (jf_tracker.lua:14030) - thanks for the report - :debug share - a debug log safe to post: names, paths and your own text are replaced - DSP: Opt+H L - the track, Opt+J K and Opt+1..0 - the instrument, as in the tracker; Shift+Opt+J K - preset, Shift+Opt+H L - preset folder; slixer lists its Option keys - plugin windows over DSP (gui): only by the gui button; they follow their own track, hide behind options, other tabs and other apps, close with the tracker and give the keyboard back - mixer: track names vertical in the tracker font, trnames and view buttons; zk - a folder wide with its children narrow - tracker: the view button next to W H; the track scroll stops at the last track

version.author: jeeruff
version.changelog: - performance: per-frame polls cached (project tabs 4 Hz, punch / pre-roll ids, smart input file, SWS check, main module label widths) - master: one view, always on the right; h hides it (a thin sum sign stays, click - show); - + N command columns (Opt+Shift+H more, L fewer) - master cmd: Enter - a menu: tempo change / ramp / half / double, time signature, jump or loop back (>0128 x4, seamless), mute / solo a track, program change, stop, metronome, a REAPER action - command line like Ivy / Helm: words in any order over commands, history, keys and REAPER actions; . before a command - at the cursor only (:.bpm 140); := - the row number - :occur (instrument number, . under the cursor, or the selection) - cyan frames, n N walk them; g? - describe a key; Ctrl+O - actions on the picked line; :winner - lib as one tree: sections, sounds with slices and layers, drumrs5k kits - pads - pad effects; replace a pad sample in place; one cursor - . repeats any tracker command (3. - three times) - track width smooth: one note column per step both ways; zw - data columns first - zT g - spectrogram track view; the note name over the wave - microtones: quarter tones as a sign in the sharp place (note always 3 chars); the sign is dim; flats only in a flat key of the song (:key, shown in the transport) - [ ] - only the keyboard octave, everywhere; Opt+Space - the step down in any mode; Cmd+two digits within 0.25 s - track 12 - BPM and note pickers take the typed value on Enter - menus opened with the mouse drop at the mouse - Enter does not auto-repeat (a slow plugin load added it three times) - slicer: a click selects a slice, it moves after 5 px; the aim is two corners on top - Shift+F remembers the database; Esc cancels the find at once - viper: an item selected in REAPER moves the cursor to it, all tracks stay visible - libkeys (Opt+M, lib2keys button, :libkeys): the note keys are the lib instruments top to bottom; INSERT writes on the instrument track - note = slice (as the slice list: S01 = C-3 ...): the note shows the slice, F1 / F2, r + note - another slice; 0Sxx - start xx/256 into the slice; slice pitch - Opt+T p (lib: Shift+T), every note of the slice follows - transport bar: one bar of the whole window at the bottom, one block with the status line (option transport on top); gone from the tracker pane - status line as a modeline: mode-coloured bar, mode without dashes, hover text on the right - mode word: major (module in focus) + minor (NORMAL INSERT KEYS ...); click - menu of all modes (:modes) - menus, which-key and pick lists open at the bottom and push the panes up (option menus at the bottom); preset lists stay at the preset - Space leader: the menu stays after Space is released; Space again or ':' - the command line, '/' - search the whole menu tree - transport: time under the position, metronome and a bigger beat counter under BPM, air between the blocks, wider buttons and keys; in keyspat / keyphr the keys carry pattern / phrase names - e - the row after the event, again - after the next one (3e); ge - after the previous one - selection shown by inversion in the tracker and the matrix (option selection inverted) - track width: narrowing hides the empty columns first (spare note sub-columns, then empty vol / delay / command columns); automation with data stays - pattern boundary in the tracker: 3 px - ending pattern colour, grey line, starting pattern colour - strictly one MIDI clip per pattern: MIDI items an edit made or moved merge into the clip of their pattern - dsp: in INSERT with the DSP in focus a moved parameter writes a point into its automation at the cursor row - envelope column: Ctrl+A / Ctrl+X step one shown unit (was four), Shift - 16 - :patai [all] - the automation of a pattern into automation items the length of the pattern, linked in its repeats (first step, by command) - :dedup - remove duplicate items (same position, length, lane, notes / source) - tL / :lanesplit - fixed lanes of a track to tracks or into a folder - lib: loop column (lp) with toggles, new samples come with loop off; < xi > next to layer; automation section removed - item properties: slider on length, ticks and a light snap at the slice edges - go to module (g t) lists hidden modules too - matrix: yw copies the cell under the cursor; empty cells of a track with automation show the dots again - theme gruber-darker; module borders 2 px with a 7 px gap; row jumps two digits wide next to the grid - mixer: mini strip in a low pane; master named in full or by the sum sign - loom switched off for now - fix: a pasted item could come out one row long (a stale note-entry length cap) - fix: copies of a linked pattern were laid at the old positions after a tempo change - fix: a track zoomed with zt stayed in the big wave view after a reload (no notes shown) - fix: Opt+digit picks by the number shown in the lib, reaches midi clips and phrases - phrases: listen from a MIDI key or Shift + a note key (the phrase tracks solo); Shift+Space on a trigger plays its transposed copies; MIDI rec writes triggers - phrases: the trigger note shows the phrase number from the lib like any instrument - no " mark, no box over the item - playlist: a phrase by its bare name (p1); the seq row explains itself in the status; Ctrl+W ? hints, I help - view buttons phr pat sec prj: phr - the phrase source in the tracker, looped - :loom man / auto - the pattern loops while you weave it; man: Opt+Enter - the next turn as a new pattern after it - :keyphr - the note keys and MIDI play the phrases - the tracker pane has a title like every pane: tracker; the second one - phrase p1 / pattern B1 - tracker 2: its own LPB (+ -) - two grids over the same time, as the REAPER playhead and edit cursor are shared - fix: a layout holding a second pane (tracker 2, dsp 2) was lost on restart; tracker 2 crashed with a fractional LPB - phrases: Enter on a trigger note opens the phrase in tracker 2; playing copies show as thin bars in it - tracker 2: Ctrl+W D on the tracker - a second tracker view with its own pattern or phrase; Enter takes the main cursor there to edit (phrase sources too) - DSP: T pins the panel to its track (° after the name), T again - follow the cursor - panes as buffers: Ctrl+W D duplicates a pane with its own state - inputs, and dsp (the copy is pinned to the cursor track, the first follows the cursor); tracker next - midi tab (own MIDI learn of the slicer) removed: its knobs and buttons are jf_tracker actions now (:learn) - seq: the written song gets a section (the list name by default); :seq write NAME - keyspat: MIDI Program Change plays the pattern of that number - :learn: patterns of the song from a controller - a knob picks, buttons next / prev (keyspat quant / sudden) - :learn - any controller on the tracker by the native REAPER learn (MIDI CC / OSC / key): jf_tracker actions - slider under the cursor, next / prev, Enter, reform, humanizer
